title: daphne oleoides var. buxifolia
intro: Daphne oleoides var. buxifolia, commonly known as the Fragrant Daphne, is a small, evergreen shrub native to the Himalayas. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing anxiety and stress, improving sleep quality, and soothing digestive issues. The health benefits of Daphne oleoides var. buxifolia are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and sedative effects, which are due to its bioactive constituents, including daphnetin, daphnoretin, and daphniphylline. Regular use of this plant is believed to help alleviate symptoms of insomnia, hypertension, and digestive disorders, making it a popular choice in traditional medicine.
